full_name: Directive (EU) 2022/2555 (NIS2) — cybersecurity risk-management, governance and reporting obligations
note: Requirements are paraphrased summaries for assessment purposes, not the legal text. Always consult the official Directive and the national transposition law.

controls.title: Governance: management body accountability
controls.requirement: The management body approves the cybersecurity risk-management measures, oversees their implementation and can be held liable for infringements. Members of the management body follow cybersecurity training.

controls.title: Risk analysis and information system security policies
controls.requirement: Policies on risk analysis and information system security are defined, approved and maintained.

controls.title: Incident handling
controls.requirement: Processes exist to prevent, detect, analyse, contain and respond to incidents.

controls.title: Business continuity and crisis management
controls.requirement: Business continuity is managed, including backup management, disaster recovery and crisis management.

controls.title: Supply chain security
controls.requirement: Security aspects of relationships with direct suppliers and service providers are assessed and managed.

controls.title: Secure acquisition, development and maintenance; vulnerability handling
controls.requirement: Security is built into the acquisition, development and maintenance of network and information systems, including vulnerability handling and disclosure.

controls.title: Effectiveness assessment of security measures
controls.requirement: Policies and procedures exist to assess whether the cybersecurity risk-management measures are effective (e.g. audits, tests, metrics).

controls.title: Cyber hygiene and security training
controls.requirement: Basic cyber hygiene practices are applied and staff receive cybersecurity training.

controls.title: Cryptography and encryption
controls.requirement: Policies and procedures govern the use of cryptography and, where appropriate, encryption.

controls.title: HR security, access control and asset management
controls.requirement: Human resources security, access control policies and asset management are in place.

controls.title: Multi-factor authentication and secured communications
controls.requirement: Multi-factor or continuous authentication is used where appropriate, along with secured voice, video and text communications and secured emergency communication systems.

controls.title: Incident reporting obligations
controls.requirement: Significant incidents are reported to the CSIRT/competent authority: early warning within 24 hours, incident notification within 72 hours and a final report within one month.
